headerDisplay: Controls Poplight Bluetooth wall sconces directly over BLE. Quit the official Poplight app (and the Poplight Mac app) while Homebridge is running: each light accepts a single connection.

autoDiscover.title: Auto-discover lights
autoDiscover.description: Add every light advertising as POP_Light that comes into range.

lowBatteryThreshold.title: Low battery threshold (%)
lowBatteryThreshold.description: At or below this level the light is flagged as low battery. The light reports 25/50/75/100.

batterySensor.title: Battery level tile
batterySensor.description: Add a '<light> Battery' humidity-style sensor per light so the percentage shows on its own tile in Home.

lowBatterySensor.title: Battery Low contact sensor
lowBatterySensor.description: Add a '<light> Battery Low' contact sensor per light. It opens at the threshold, so Home can send a notification and automations can react.

lights.title: Lights
lights.description: Optional names for specific lights. With auto-discover off, only these lights are added.

id.title: Peripheral id
id.description: As logged by the plugin when the light is discovered (UUID on macOS, MAC address on Linux).
